verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਦਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lok vedh sun aakhadhaa sun sun giaanee giaan vakhaanai|

en.bdb: The so - called knowledgeable persons having listened to the Vedas as their knowledge about the world on the basis of hears

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਲੋਕ ਸਣੁ ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਤ ਪਤਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: surag lok san maat lok sun sun saat pataal na jaanai|

en.bdb: The  also learn about heavens, mother earth and all the seven odds, but still they donot know the real truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਨ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤ ਹੋਏ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhoot bhavikh na varatamaan aadh madh a(n)t hoe hairaanai|

en.bdb: Neither do they hand the past future and the present, nor the mystery of the beginning middle, but are simply wonderstruck

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਮ ਨੀਚ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਝਿ ਨ ਸਕਣਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: autam madham neech hoi samajh na sakan choj viddaanai|

en.bdb: Through their classifications medium and low varnas they cannot understand the great play.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਜ ਗੁਣ ਤਮ ਗੁਣ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣ ਆਖਾਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: raj gun tam gun aakheeaai sat gun sun aakhaan vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Engrossed in actions (rajoguni), inertia (tamoguni) and tranquillity (satoguni) also talk and listen,

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਸਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: man bach karam s bharamadhe saadhasa(n)gat satigur na sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: But without understanding the holy nation and the true Guru, they wander through the activities of their eech and actions.
